note: sails from Christiania on St. Hans' Day
Greenland ports: Qeqertarsuaq (Godhavn) for dogs and stores
across Melville Bay past Cape York
Foulke Fiord, on the Greenland shore
beset in Rice Strait: Fram Havn, first winter quarters 1898-99
summer 1899: barred by ice from going north up Kane Basin
turns south along the Ellesmere shore
Goose Fiord (Gaasefjord), third and fourth winter quarters 1900-02
free at last, east through Jones Sound
noon position in the Atlantic; boiler crowns burned down that afternoon
Stavanger: home after four years and three months
